## 1. Title
Why We Invested: Courtline

## 2. The trend Courtside has been tracking
At Courtside, we've been closely tracking how pickup sports moved onto phones. Courtline's seed round names 40,000 weekly players ([seed story](https://courtline.example/news/seed)).

## 3. The turn
It is with this backdrop that we are thrilled to announce Courtline's $2.5M seed ([seed story](https://courtline.example/news/seed)).

## 4. What the company does
Courtline books open courts and fills pickup games by skill level ([site](https://courtline.example)).

## 5. The founders
See Questions for Founders below.

## 6. Why now, and why it's venture scale
Pickup play is growing, and court time is still booked by phone call. Market size is still to confirm with the team.

## 7. Where it goes next
See Questions for Founders below.
